keyRecipe.expression: sha256(recipe 3, bundle name, HEAD^{tree}, ImageOS + RUNNER_ARCH, exact bun/git/node/python3/java versions, every state ref tip + qa-reports head, extras)

derivedInputs: the tree of the commit (the writers declare {tracked}), the exact tool versions the writers call, and the tips of the state branches they read
savePolicy: each run that built the bundle uploads it plus a `bundle-<name>-<digest>` record artifact last; artifacts are run-scoped, so the trust is in the reader's source rule
verify: bundle-cache.sh fetch: (1) source run's head is this head, a parent of this commit, or a commit with this tree; (2) the tar matches manifest.txt; (3) the bundle names no foreign run id, commit or <n>/merge (until 69lr/#1509 removes the stamps)
owner: CI speed 10 (session_01VQDpPd7y4nwxjHFm66CMKF); ported onto cached-step by CI speed 14 after #2965

refs: cat/<instance>/health, for each mounted instance whose health graph is kept on a branch (cat-harness-tools, cat-harness and those of the layers above)
stateInputs.how: every ref state:mount laid down (its own markers under <git-dir>/branch-mounts/*.json) plus the qa-reports head: each ref's tip is a `digest input: state …` line (bundle-cache.sh RECIPE=3); an unreadable marker or head is no digest, so the job builds. Measured 2026-11-05 ~14:40Z in a folio-assistant cloud checkout by CI speed 10: 12 refs, three of them `cat/<instance>/health` (written here as one entry, since naming a layer above this one is the wrong direction); a runner's set is what its run log prints. Narrowing to the refs a writer actually reads waits on the writer-cone read sets.

notes: folio-assistant #2965/#2966. Not byte-reproducible yet: same commit eaa6558, runs 42025861803 and 42030336059, QA manifests 17f6fa0a… vs 7ba8341b… (determinism audit's first row).
title: Generated set: the QA working copy
holds: qa-working-copy.tar and manifest.txt: the test/results the QA writers produce over the tree
producer: code-quality-gates.yml job qa-working-copy (bun run cat qa:working-copy)
consumers: the gate jobs that read test/results
Feature Staging's stage (qa-copy-reuse.sh, to move onto cached-step)

refresh.how: rebuilt by qa:working-copy; incremental per writer once the writer cone records read sets
